evals.prompt: Je fais une app de livraison en Swift, je veux un backend qui pousse le statut du colis en live vers l'app iOS pendant que le livreur se déplace, sans spammer l'API du transporteur en continu.
evals.expected_output: A Swift package (Vapor + grpc-swift) with a shared .proto contract for package/delivery status, an adaptive poller that slows down when no delivery is in transit and speeds up when one is active, an actor-based cache, and an AsyncStream broadcaster for pushing live status to iOS clients. Should build successfully.
assertions: Package.swift declares dependencies on vapor and on grpc-swift (grpc-swift-nio-transport, grpc-swift-protobuf, swift-protobuf)
A .proto file exists defining a server-streaming RPC (a 'stream' response) relevant to package/delivery status
An actor-isolated cache type exists with a per-key TTL/expiry mechanism
A pub/sub broadcaster type exists using AsyncStream to fan out updates to multiple subscribers
An adaptive/variable-interval polling mechanism exists (not a single fixed sleep duration) that scales based on whether a delivery is active vs idle
The generated Swift package builds successfully with `swift build`
No literal '{{' template placeholders remain in any generated file
